### Props

| Name     | Type     | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `report` | `object` |          | `null`  | A step's messaging report: the run-log entry's `report.messaging`. Each outcome bucket is `{count, sample}`; a `refusedRecipients` sample entry is `{recipient, reason}`. `null` renders nothing. |
| `labels` | `object` |          | `\{\}`  | Names to use instead of the built-in ones, keyed by bucket (`{ optedOut: 'Unsubscribed' }`). Pass already-translated text.                                                                        |
